name: Dorsett Mongkok Hong Kong
detail: The shuttle service is amazing, comfortable and on time. I used the service from Kowloon Station and the ride took about 20min to reach the hotel due to the narrow one way streets in Hong Kong that made it very inconvenient for cars to get around. We had to make many winding turns before reaching the hotel, that explains the 20min gap from the Station to the Hotel. Upon arrival, services like taking care of your luggage and opening doors for you are part of the expected overall experience package. To enhance the experience, this hotel has a very interesting service, free service, where they had a smartphone with free WiFi and IDD calls waiting for me in my room. Totally free of charge. I used this phone to the max. i.e. Google Maps, looking for deals nearby and never had to worry about getting lost anymore. This is my third visit to Hong Kong and I was able to get around comfortably while connected, this service should be made available worldwide!! Rooms are extremely well maintained and the chambermaids too do their jobs proficiently. Location too is convenient, 5 mins walk to Olympic Station and about 15 mins walk to Langham Mall. There's a McCafe opposite the hotel and the nearest supermart (Wellcome) is to the right of McCafe, about 5 mins down. There are various 'cha chaan tengs' around Dorsett Mongkok too if you are looking for the authentic Hong Kong breakfast/tea-time experience. Breakfast sets go as low as HKD28. Cafe de Coral is just around the corner too, so is 759 Store. Apliu Street is also 20 mins away by the green mini bus, just outside Wellcome. If you are going back to Dorsett Mongkok from Star Ferry Pier (Tsim Sha Tsui), Bus 1/1A along Nathan Rd. does the trick, or go to China HK City Ferry for the shuttle. Otherwise, walk to Ashley Rd. for minibus 3 and request to get off at Tai Kok Tsui Rd. Overall, I'm impressed with this hotel and I would definitely book with Dorsett Mongkok once more.

name: The Mahjong Boutique Hostel
detail: It was my first time as a solo female traveler in a hostel, and I was gladly surprised. The female bedroom is organized, very clean, and only accessible through the use of the card key, which guarantees safety, as well as the locker located inside the cabin. The restroom inside the bedroom is always clean, they provide toiletries and the showers are great. I didn't get to explore the neighborhood, but the hostel is right beside bus stops that can take you wherever you want in Hong Kong! The staff was very nice, made me feel very welcomed , and was always very happy to help when I needed directions. Overall great place! If I ever go back to Hong Kong I will for sure stay there again!

name: Mini Central
detail: It was quite a walk up the steep slopes and stairs, but hey, it is hong kong after all right? Though the hotel was found sandwiched between two other building, it stood out due to it's small build making it easy to find. Entering the hotel, we were greeted with a very beautifully lobby area which was furnished with modern and contemporary furniture. There were two imacs available for use and even a piano, which i was very much tempted to play but my next to zero instrumental skills prevented me. We were briskly checked in and showed to our room by the efficient, if not so friendly, staffs there. We weren't exactly shocked by the size of the room, having done our research prior to booking the room. In fact, i actually felt that it was better than i'd expected it to be! It would've been very annoying to move around if we had brought big luggages but we were only travelling with backpacks so it wasn't really much of a hassle for us! Besides, when you're in hong kong you wouldn't be staying in that much since there's lots to do. Aside from that, i actually like the fact that the toilet had clear glass walls. It allowed me to watch the telly, not that there was anything to watch actually considering the limited channels they have, and go about my big business all at the same time. Also, toiletries was not provided but can be easily bought from a dispenser at the ground floor, Overall, we're really satisfied with our stay there. It was a really nice hotel with an affordable price. Unless you really don't enjoy small spaces i'm pretty sure you'll like the place! Well, we definitely did and wouldn't mind coming back if i were to visit hong kong again!

name: Atlas Guest House & Backpackers
detail: Excellent hotel and owner. I booked this hotel for my fiance while she was traveling alone and there was a misunderstanding with the booking and the owner was very good to work with. He gave me his personal WhatsApp number so he and I could work out all the details. He was very patient and my fiance had a great experience while staying. I would definitely book again while in Hong Kong.

name: Bishop Lei International House
detail: My wife and I lived in Hong Kong twice, for a total of four years. For most of that time we lived at mid-level on the Victoria side, and we loved the view we had, day and night. There are many more luxurious and famous hotels in Hong Kong, but at Bishop Lei we can have an excellent hotel, at a very reasonable price. We like the small but functional suites which have a bedroom with floor-to-ceiling windows. In the daytime we can look down on the Governor’s house and Central, with lots of greenery too. At night we have a fabulous view! The staff is efficient there is a good outdoor swimming pool, and the location, at the top of the Hong Kong escalator is perfect. In the morning we can take the escalator down, and in the evening or afternoon take it up. There are many good restaurants in the lively Lan Kwai Fong area along the escalator path, so it is easy to go out for dinner without having to go very far. The hotel also has a regular shuttle service to downtown and airport express.

name: Homy Central
detail: I am suppose to book from this hotel during my first trip in Hong Kong but they got sold out really fast! Luckily this January of 2019, I was able to book 2 rooms. The staff that attended our check-in is really efficient and very friendly. The rooms we got are really spacious, very minimalist but that's how we like it and clean. The location is amazing, like 50 steps away from the train station. The price is relatively cheap knowing that this is Hong Kong and were in the central part. Hong Kong holds a special place in our hearts and I will definitely stay in this cozy homy hotel when I come back. Keep up the great service Homy Hotel Central!

name: Regal Airport Hotel
detail: I was only there one day but could see that it is a top-class hotel. It has al the mod-cons in the room including a massive LED TV with a welcoming message for you and even speakers in the bathroom. Going to this hotel also really helped as I arrived at about 1am in Hong Kong and so didn't need to look for taxis or late-night transport and then hassle with check-ins in Hong Kong City. Most times you can only check in after 2pm anyway. And the good thing is it is not any more expensive than the normal (and usually much smaller) hotels in Hong Kong City.

name: Check Inn HK
detail: This is a cheap, friendly hostel right in the heart of Wan Chai, in a perfect place area in Hong Kong for me! It is close to the metro station and the buses to and from the airport and the rest of Hong Kong so it's easily accessible. Taxis weren't too expensive either. At first, it may be a bit difficult to find because it is not very clearly marked, but just look at the numbers on the doors to help! The rooms were clean and tidy (and I shared with all boys so can only get better) and I was pleasantly surprised at how comfy the beds were! There are lockers in the room that were safe and plenty of communal areas to relax in. There were some useful facilities; computers, wifi and towels to rent. There are lots of fun, friendly people here. The staff were super helpful and also held lots of events for anyone that wanted to take part...and I made so brilliant friends which was great as I was traveling alone! I had the best time here and will definitely be staying here again!!!
